run_precompute_enumerate_surface: run the CLI script to precompute and enumerate surface structures for a bulk crystal index
build_enumerate_surfaces_for_saving: build a function to enumerate all symmetrically distinct surfaces of a bulk crystal structure up to a max Miller index
create_standardize_bulk: create a function that standardizes a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure using spacegroup analysis
test_is_structure_invertible: test whether a pymatgen Structure object is symmetric in the z-direction by checking its spacegroup operations
refactor_flip_struct: refactor a pymatgen Structure to flip it upside down by rotating 180 degrees around the x-axis
